I'm sick and tired of everything in this city. Let's leave! ' The main character, Haerang, who was terrible to people in the city, I head to my grandmother's hometown full of childhood memories. A special friend who was the only one who cared for him there. I meet 'Miro' again. the excessive interest of the villagers Even if you back down from the strange exclusion of young people, It's a sea trick to approach two steps and solve relationships with people. As I approach, I feel sorry for Miro, who runs away again in three steps. Why not? Did I like you? Didn't you like me, too? discrimination that was received because of mixed-race children, A labyrinth with fear of someone leaving. Haerang, who has been discriminated against for the rest of his life because he is weak. Because of sticking to the unusual style of long hair, Daeseok, who was criticized by prejudice, Ok-hee, who has been rejected by her parents for not being like a woman. Other youths with their own discrimination and circumstances A story about how to comfort each other and overcome it.
